metadata.notes: TRIGGER (replaces the old 15-min Supabase poll). The backend fires this webhook the instant createPublicAtsApplication records a candidate.created event (backend/src/services/eventService.ts MAKE_DISPATCH). Body is a single applicant bundle: application_id, application_code, status, agency_id, full_name, nationality. Keeping this module's id = 2 means downstream modules keep their {{2.application_id}} / {{2.application_code}} / {{2.status}} references unchanged. On import: click this module, Add a webhook named 'Applicant Intake (event)', copy its URL into the backend env MAKE_WEBHOOK_URL_APPLICANT_INTAKE.
Fetch the matching profile (helped_query_ats_profiles.application_id). Replace YOUR-PROJECT-REF and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.
AI screening summary (Claude). Replace ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Model id claude-sonnet-4-6; use claude-opus-4-8 for higher quality.

REPORT BACK TO THE OPERATOR. Records screening.completed in public.workflow_events so the backend and the #4 health detector know the machine finished. Replace YOUR-DOMAIN with your site origin and EVENT_INGEST_SECRET with the shared secret from the backend .env. Closes the loop: candidate.created -> screening.completed.
